[[File:Syren_plant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Syren plant]]
The [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] '''Syren plants''' were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They could be found in the dangerous [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the planet's surface, far below the canopy level where the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] dwelled.<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

A Syren [[Plant/Legends|plant]] could be identified by its two ovular, bright [[Color/Legends|yellow]] petals that were divided in half. The petals were mounted on an extremely thick, mottled, [[Blood/Legends|blood]]-red stalk. In the middle of the petals was a tuft of glossy white fibers. To many casual observers, the plant might have seemed little more than a giant, beautiful, oversized [[Flower/Legends|flower]].

[[File:Lowbacca18.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Lowbacca]] with his syren fiber belt]]
The tuft of [[Syren-fiber|Syren fibers]] within the plant emitted a large number of [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], which could lure unsuspecting prey. If a creature was lured within proximity of the yellow petals, it was unlikely to survive. Touching the blood-red inner flesh of a Syren plant's petals would cause it to reflexively close in one swift powerful movement. The prey, now trapped by the plant's powerful and sticky petals, would be painfully digested alive. The fibers could be woven by the Wookiees to make items such as belts.

As a rite of passage, many young Wookiees would attempt to harvest the plant's Syren fibers at the [[Well of the Dead]]. A young Wookiee would typically bring a few strong friends to hold the powerful petals in place while he attempted to harvest the fibers as quickly as possible. Thereafter, he wear the Syren fibers as a symbol of virility and bravery. Despite the help from comrades, some young Wookiees lost [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] to the plant. Before [[Gender/Legends|he]] attended [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]], [[Lowbacca]] managed to harvest the Syren fibers by himself, while hanging from a rope above an open plant. While the plant's reflexes were accidentally triggered by a stray end of rope falling and brushing one of the petals, Lowbacca sensed it immediately and managed to pull himself clear from the petals' range before it closed. Returning home, he wove the fibers into a [[Belt/Legends|belt]].

In the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Vonnda Ra]] lost her balance during a struggle with Lowbacca's sister [[Sirrakuk]] and caused them to fall into the maw of a Syren plant. While Sirrakuk escaped the voracious plant along with a handful of Syren fibers, Ra was consumed.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]''</ref>

The [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] kept Syren plants in her luxurious and notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] within her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Adventures">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An [[Syren spice|unidentified spice]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "Man Down!"</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> This spice was one of the central elements of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" story arc, introduced upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]," on [[March 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> In the cut fifth chapter of "Secrets of the Syren,"<ref name="ID">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref><ref name="P28">{{WebCite|url=https://forums.mmorpg.com/discussion/72650/pub-28-notes|text=Pub 28 Notes|date=2006-03-31|archivedate=20250517222106}}</ref><ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> it should have been revealed that the spice was extracted from the roots of Syren plants.<ref name="SWG:SotSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Quest: "Secrets of the Syren: Endgame"}}</ref>
